finalText:
All objectives complete and verified.

**1. DONE** — Ticket created: **RD-1015**, title `s2bp RD Bench Ticket`, customer "Bench Customer", initial status Draft (created 2026-08-22).

**2. DONE** — Part `s2bp RD Part A` added with Cost $100.00, Markup 25%, Qty 1, Supplier "Bench Supplier". Computed **Price: $125.00**.

**3. DONE** — Part `s2bp RD Part B` added with Cost $200.00, Markup 25%, Qty 1, Supplier "Bench Supplier". Computed **Price: $250.00**. (Table total at that point: $375.00.)

**4. DONE** — Part A edited, Cost 100 → 150 (markup unchanged at 25%). Computed **Price: $187.50**. Table total updated to $437.50.

**5. DONE** — Ticket RD-1015 ends in status **Ready** (verified persisted after navigating away and back). The app enforces preconditions via a native alert titled "Ticket is not ready"; I discovered them experimentally on a scratch ticket (RD-1016) so RD-1015 was never left in a bad state. Exactly **two** preconditions were found, and satisfying both was sufficient:
   - **At least one part must exist on the ticket.** Alert text: `Ticket is not ready — A ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked Ready`.
   - **Every part on the ticket must have a supplier.** Alert text: `Ticket is not ready — Part "s2bp RD Probe Part" has no supplier`.
   
   A missing customer does **not** block Ready (the probe ticket had no customer and still reached Ready once the two conditions above were met). RD-1015 already satisfied both conditions when I clicked Mark Ready, so it transitioned Draft → Ready with no alert.

**6. DONE** — Both parts deleted from RD-1015, each via a custom "Confirm" dialog reading `Delete the part "<name>" from this ticket? This cannot be undone.` (confirmed with "Delete part"). Parts section now shows the empty state "No parts on this ticket yet." with no total row. Ticket then archived (no confirmation prompt; button became "Unarchive ticket", an "Archived" badge appeared beside Status: Ready). Final check: the active Tickets list shows 13 tickets with **no** `s2bp` rows; with "Show archived" ticked, both appear as `RD-1015 | s2bp RD Bench Ticket Archived | Bench Customer | Ready | 0` and `RD-1016 | s2bp RD Probe Archived | Not recorded | Ready | 1`. Nothing created by this run remains active.

Note: I created one extra scratch ticket, `s2bp RD Probe` (RD-1016), purely to probe the Ready preconditions without disturbing RD-1015. It was also archived, so it leaves nothing active either.
